messages:
Maria Ramos: Quick heads-up — hotfix PR #9760 needs dual signoff before tonight's 18:00 PT cutover. Affects kv-cache TTL; we've seen repeated OOMs in prod canary. CI is green and staging smoke passed.
AJ Patel: I'm taking first review now, will ping if I hit anything.
Sam K: I can take second if AJ is ok. Quick q: does this touch the shard routing code?
Maria Ramos: No routing changes, just TTL config + guard. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9760
Toni Chen: Left a tiny comment about retry backoff — @Lee Park can you address? otherwise looks low-risk.
Lee Park: Thanks, pushed a small fix and added a unit test. Re-requested review.
AJ Patel: Reviewing... small nit but not blocking.
AJ Patel: Approved — looks good from my side :white_check_mark:
Sam K: Ran the staging canary for 20m after the patch — memory profile stabilizes. I approve.
Maria Ramos: Awesome, that's the dual signoff we need. @deploy-bot please schedule cutover.
deploy-bot: cutover scheduled for 2024-06-12T18:00:00PT — will auto-hold if approvals < 2 at T-15m.
Lee Park: Thanks everyone, I'll monitor post-cutover and keep the runbook open.
Maria Ramos: Copying notes to the release ticket and tagging ops. If anyone wants to review the smoke logs:
```
curl -s https://staging-metrics/api/v1/kv-cache | jq '.memory | .p50, .p95'
```
Maria Ramos: Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
